scope.method: Independent visual inspection of each complete original image with view_image at original detail. No crops, image edits, generation, detector, model execution, prompt information, seed information, or other files were used.
scope.bbox_format: [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] in full-image coordinates, approximately estimated by the observing AI; not detector measurements. Bounds describe visible regions, including the visible remainder of cropped objects.
scope.color_method: Visible body colors were recorded without comparison to any target prompt. Colors of ambiguous identities are not_assessable; descriptive visible hues may be retained in notes.
scope.relationship_method: Only exactly one clear, uniquely localizable cube and exactly one clear, uniquely localizable sphere qualify. A confident horizontal-center separation of at least 25.6 px is required for left/right.

clear_objects.notes: A large rounded, ball-like volume with an elliptical outer contour and curved surface cues, although its interior is divided into angular facets. The body contains substantial red, blue/cyan, and unpainted white regions; neither red nor blue is a clear uniform dominant body color.

ambiguous_candidates.notes: Small pink/red angular region at lower left has possible top/side face cues, but its right side joins the larger red structure and its complete block geometry and distinct-object boundary are unclear.

Large red upper-left plane, blue upper-right plane, and blue lower plane form an angular surrounding structure. Much is hidden by the ball, cut by the image boundary, or merged with paint washes; a single coherent cube-like block cannot be established.
A narrow red rectangular patch at the right edge has little convincing depth and does not independently establish a cube.

horizontal_relation.reason: No clear cube; the angular structures cannot supply a unique confidently identified cube paired with the clear sphere.

secondary.background: Exposed areas are off-white textured paper, with extensive red and blue geometric planes and paint washes filling most of the setting.
secondary.extra_objects_or_forms: Several angular surround/block-like forms and the isolated-looking right red rectangle, all retained above as ambiguous candidates rather than extra clear cubes.
secondary.overlap_occlusion_merging: The ball overlaps the surrounding planes; several red regions merge. The ball remains largely localizable.
secondary.cropping: Surrounding red/blue structure reaches and is cut by the top and right boundaries; lower wash approaches or touches the bottom. The main ball is not image-edge cropped.

clear_objects.notes: A box-like block has a nearly square front and a contrasting visible right side, which provide coherent volume cues despite right-edge cropping. Its front contains a red perimeter, a large purple/pink area, and a white lower region; the side is pale cyan/teal with darker teal edges. The visible body has conflicting colors.

ambiguous_candidates.notes: A broad red region descends below the upper block and exits the bottom/right edges. It could be an attached support, another block, or a wash; no separate cube volume is securely visible.

secondary.cropping: The main block is cut off at the right boundary. The lower red extension is cut off at the bottom and right.

ambiguous_candidates.notes: Red-bordered quadrilateral within the ball; it reads as a surface/reflection motif and does not establish a separate three-dimensional cube.

Blue angular patch in the lower-left interior of the ball; surface-like, without enough distinct faces to establish a cube.
Small light circular motif with a blue rim inside the large sphere. It lacks sufficient independent volume cues and may be a flat marking or reflection.
